# Kevin Jose — Photography, Film, Branding & Digital Ads (Dubai, UAE)

> Kevin Jose is a Dubai-based photographer and filmmaker who also builds brands and runs paid digital marketing ads for businesses across the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the Northern Emirates). Working since 2018, shooting on Sony FX3 and A7R V.

## Services
- Photography & videography: brand films, commercial, product, food and lifestyle photography, real estate photo and video, weddings and events.
- Brand building: strategy and positioning, logo and visual identity, brand guidelines, tone of voice and mood, brand photography, website and ecommerce builds.
- Digital marketing ads: campaigns on Instagram/Facebook (Meta), TikTok, Google/YouTube and Snapchat targeted to UAE audiences, with ad creative shot and edited in-house.
- Gear rental: cameras, lenses, lighting and grip in Dubai, day and weekend rates.

## Selected brand work
- Layla Flowers (Dubai florist): full brand from name and logo to product photography and an ecommerce website.
- Sama Beirut (butchery & food brand, Beirut): identity, guidelines, food photography and a website with online ordering.
